en.text: The plane should have arrived at Kansai Airport by now.

indices: 其の[01]{その} 飛行機 は 今ごろ は 関西~ 空港 に 当然 着く(つく)[01]{着いている} 筈[01]{はず}~ だ

original: あの飛行機に乗っていたら、今頃はもう死んでいるだろうね。

en.text: Had I taken that plane, I would be dead by now.
If we'd been on that plane, we'd be dead now.
If we'd taken that plane, we'd be dead now.

original: もし怠け者でなかったら彼は今頃リッチになっているかもしれない。

en.text: If he wasn't lazy, he might be rich by now.

original: 来週の今頃には、俺たちは何をしてるだろう？

en.text: What will we be doing this time next week?

original: 彼女は今頃もう村に到着してるよ。

en.text: I'm sure that she has arrived at the village by now.

original: 彼女の助けがなかったら、私は今頃生きていないだろう。

en.text: If it weren't for her help, I would not be alive now.

original: 我々は明日の今ごろはロンドンにいるだろう。

en.text: About this time tomorrow, we will be in London.

original: トムは今頃ここにいることになっているはずだ。

en.text: Tom is supposed to be here by now.

original: トムは今頃ここにいるものだと思っていました。

en.text: I thought Tom would be here by now.
I thought that Tom would be here by now.

original: 昨日の今ごろは何してた？

en.text: What were you doing about this time yesterday?

original: 多分今頃はもう、トムはメアリーにキスしてるよ。

en.text: Tom has probably kissed Mary by now.

original: 明日の今頃って、私たちロンドンだね。

en.text: About this time tomorrow, we will be in London.

original: 明日の今頃って、私たちボストンだね。

en.text: About this time tomorrow, we'll be in Boston.

original: 世が世なら今頃いい仕事をしているはずだ。

en.text: If the circumstances were better, I'd have a good job by now.

original: 「今頃、朝食？」「朝方寝て、ちょっと前に起きたばかりなの」

en.text: "You're still eating breakfast at this time of day?" "I slept in this morning and I just got up."

original: 去年の今頃って、何してた？

en.text: What were you doing this time last year?
